gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-lexend: Lexend reads wide, smooth and friendly, with curves that stay open. Capture Smallz stomps in with big-bodied, raw lowercase, and the tubelike lines of Lexend give the eye somewhere steady to rest.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-a: Capture Smallz is raw and tactical, with big-bodied lowercase letters. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined adds generous gaps at its curve ends, and that spacious, modern body is the pair's main draw.

Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads tall and modern, its terminal tips flaring outward. Capture Smallz does raw, big-bodied lowercase attitude best, while the sans-serif below it does best with an x-height nearing cap height.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-b: Noto Sans Bamum reads modern and clean, its curved strokes stopping short and every small letter holding a big open counter. Capture Smallz makes the noise, then paragraphs below it flow without snagging.

Noto Sans Batak reads sturdy, with a towering x-height and an open e. Capture Smallz brings the raw, tactical shout up top, and paragraphs of the Batak text should stay approachable rather than tiring.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-e: Rough, chunky and tactical: Capture Smallz hits first, with big-bodied lowercase. Noto Sans Elbasan takes over with open terminals that never pinch shut, so paragraphs of text should move along smoothly.

Capture Smallz is all raw, big-bodied lowercase with a tactical bite. Noto Sans Ethiopic adds a tall, sturdy lowercase with c terminals hanging far from the bowl, and that sturdiness carries the pair.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-g: Loud, rough and tactical, Capture Smallz muscles in first with big lowercase. Noto Sans Gujarati brings clean, modern curves that stop before turning inward, and its open counters are the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-i: Blunt and raw, Capture Smallz stomps in with big lowercase. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic then steps in with open-pincer c ends and a short hop from lowercase to capitals, keeping everything approachable.
gen-dafont-capture-smallz-gf-noto-sans-k: Raw and tactical, Capture Smallz swaggers in with big-bodied lowercase. Noto Sans Kayah Li lifts its brush ends before curves close and keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, so the swagger stays readable.
